meta.description: Shared red-team corpus for the contact filter (owner rule: no phone numbers, IBANs or social media names/abbreviations in text other users can see). Every 'block' text must be refused; every 'allow' text must pass unchanged.
meta.categoryNote: A few texts carry more than one kind of contact detail; their category is the first kind in categoryPriority that matches. 'iban' also covers bank account and card numbers; 'payment' covers Papara, ininal, Tosla, Paycell, PayPal, Payfix, crypto exchanges and wallet addresses; 'link' also covers link shorteners and link pages typed without the dot ('t me ayse', 'linktree ayse').
meta.invisibleCharacters: Zero-width, format and combining characters are written as \u escapes (U+200B, U+200C, U+200D, U+2060, U+FEFF, U+00AD, U+0336, U+0332) so the cases stay readable.
meta.handles: The app has no @mention feature, so every @ followed by a handle blocks. '@_@' is an emoticon, not a handle.
meta.inAppIds: In-app IDs are meant to be shared: user ID 12 digits (displayId), room ID 8 digits from 10000000 (roomCode), Tayfa ID 7 digits. The allow list has one of each next to the word ID. A 12-digit number of the user ID shape that holds a mobile number ('105321234567' is '10' and 0532 123 45 67) passes only if it is a real ID (100000000000 + 7919 × k).
meta.sequences: Consecutive messages from one sender in one conversation, sent within a minute. A block sequence must be refused no later than its last message; every message of an allow sequence must pass.
